B1.description: 4 one-symbol maps plus all 256 one-bit-state deterministic step tables over the binary alphabet

B2.description: all 4-state deterministic step tables over the binary alphabet; 8^8 presentations; NOT enumerated by this package

search_S1.procedure: random-restart single-entry mutation hill-climb on the development graph
search_S1.objective: exact mismatch count over all words of length <= 6

search_S2.procedure: residual right-congruence construction from the specification over prefixes of length <= 3 and continuations of length <= 3, quotient read off as a step table

B2.all_words_certification: product-state comparison against the specification's reference transducer

regime_predictions_operational_vocabular.definition: persistent-state-dependent output := there exist two reachable internal states and one input symbol on which the emitted output differs

N1.quantity: state-dependent-output rate over uniformly random B1 step tables

N2.quantity: exact count of regime present/absent assignments matching the observed outcome vector: 1 of C(5,2)=10 at B1, 1 of 8 at B2

N3.quantity: exact delay2 solver rate over uniformly random B2 step tables
